title: Ember Tides

lead_centering.root_cause: Mixer track 4 pan stored as 6800. Mixer pan readback uses 0 for centre, so 6800 is beyond hard right. The SDK setter documentation claims 6400 is centre, which is only true for channel-rack pan.

evidence_before.source: installer 0.1.29 isolated audition of pattern 88 with lead and master effects retained

lead_centering.fix: set_mixer_pan(track=4, value=0), verified in a separate request

evidence_after.source: Ember-Tides/audition-v006-lead-centered.wav, playlist reduced to the pattern 42 clip, bars 41-48, lead and master effects retained

lead_presence.brightness_automation_channel_18: interior points mapped v*0.9+0.2; endpoints untouched (protected)

chords.brightness_automation_channel_13: interior points mapped v*1.05+0.14; endpoints untouched (protected)

chorus_sevenths_added.rule: one seventh below the top voice per stab whose triad lacked a seventh; stabs that already contained a seventh were left alone

chorus_I_window_spectral.analyzer: FFmpeg aspectralstats win_size=4096, mean over frames

audition_duration.cause: Transport play range reads [0..39935] with only that clip present; tick 39936 is the 'Outro - afterglow' time marker at bar 105. FL extends the song end to the last time marker. Automation clips were not the cause: all five span the full 112 bars.
audition_duration.sdk_gap: list_markers and add_marker exist; there is no delete_marker operation, so an audition cannot shorten a marker-extended render through the SDK.

limits: Listening feedback remains authoritative for musical quality
Sub-oscillator shape is display-verified; oscillator A wavetable identity is still not readable
No preset was loaded; all sound changes use exposed parameters
